questions.q: What is the core idea behind Intelligent Query Processing (IQP) features like Adaptive Joins?
options: The plan corrects course while the query is still executing, based on actual data, rather than relying only on the optimizer's upfront estimate
IQP requires a DBA to manually rewrite every query first
IQP only works on columnstore indexes, never rowstore tables
IQP replaces the need for any indexes at all
questions.explain: Adaptive Joins specifically pick between Nested Loops and Hash Join after seeing the actual row count, not before.

questions.q: What does Memory Grant Feedback actually do?
options: If a query was granted too much or too little memory last time, the next execution adjusts the grant based on what actually happened
It permanently fixes a query's memory grant the very first time it runs
It has nothing to do with memory allocation at all
It only applies to queries running in Query Store
questions.explain: This is a runtime-feedback loop across executions, not a one-time fix.

questions.q: How does Automatic Tuning relate to Lesson 49's manual Query Store regression-fixing process?
options: It does the same job automatically — monitoring Query Store, forcing the last known-good plan, and reverting if the forced plan doesn't actually help
Automatic Tuning has no relationship to Query Store at all
Automatic Tuning replaces Query Store entirely
Automatic Tuning only works on databases that have never had a regression
questions.explain: Automatic Tuning closes the loop on the exact manual process taught in Lesson 49, using the same Query Store data.

questions.q: Why does a DBA still need to understand Lesson 49's manual process even with Automatic Tuning enabled?
options: A genuinely new query has no "last good plan" to fall back to, and understanding what Automatic Tuning did still requires reading Query Store
Automatic Tuning never actually works, so the manual process is the only real option
Automatic Tuning is only available in on-prem SQL Server, never Azure SQL
There is no reason — Automatic Tuning fully replaces the manual process
questions.explain: Automatic Tuning won't catch every regression, and interpreting its actions still requires the Query Store skill from Lesson 49.

questions.q: What does IQP and Automatic Tuning NOT do, according to this lesson?
options: Design a missing index, diagnose a blocking chain, or replace the troubleshooting methodology from Lesson 44
Correct a bad row-count estimate at runtime
Monitor Query Store for a plan regression
Force a previously known-good execution plan
questions.explain: These automatic features are a real layer on top of Chapter 8's manual skills, not a substitute for index design, blocking diagnosis, or methodology.
